text: "Hosico in a transparent cat backpack is carried through a park, then the carrier sits on a bench."

"At night, Hosico sits in a transparent cat backpack on a wooden bench. The front opens, revealing Hosico looking curious. He extends his paw, exploring, while the camera shows different angles of him observing."
"Hosico, a cat in a transparent backpack, sits calmly on a spinning playground merry-go-round."
"At 40.32s, Hosico, a cat, sits in a transparent backpack on a swinging playground swing, looking curious. Soon, Hosico is outside, wearing a harness and leash, exploring the artificial grass."
"Hosico, a cat in a green harness, walks on artificial grass, stopping to sniff, while a person walks alongside."
"Hosico, a cat in a green harness, walks on artificial grass, stops near a slide, and looks curious as someone approaches."
"At 80.92s, a person on a playground holds a green leash connected to Hosico, a harnessed cat. The cat stands and starts walking forward."
"Hosico, a ginger cat, walks on artificial grass toward a transparent backpack. Assisted by a person, Hosico enters the backpack. The person lifts the backpack and walks along a park pathway."
